description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Requirement You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

Strike a wall, floor, ceiling, vehicle, or structure within your reach. It fails structurally: a 15-foot section collapses, becomes difficult terrain, and drops every creature standing on or against it prone unless they succeed at a Reflex save against your Class DC. Creatures caught in the collapse take @Damage[6d10[bludgeoning]] damage, halved on a success. The GM decides what else was holding that section up.
